design.rationale: A single low-cost Linux VM can use native Azure DNS, IMDS managed identity and Blob Private Link without public IP, NAT, VPN, SSH or guest internet. Reviewed cloud-init starts a bounded verifier; managed boot diagnostics carries nonsecret serial evidence to the operator.
design.runCommandExclusion: Microsoft documents outbound 443 to Azure public IPs for Run Command results; it is not assumed to work in this no-egress design.
design.cidrStatus: proposed; isolated VNet with no peering, VPN or reused DNS links
allowedGuestPaths: TCP 443 only to the actually assigned blob Private Endpoint address, discovered from the deployed NIC and verified against DNS.
Azure platform WireServer 168.63.129.16 TCP 80/32526 for provisioning/agent readiness; not an allocated customer public IP or general internet route.
IMDS 169.254.169.254 TCP 80 for VM identity/metadata and the storage-audience token; never log tokens.
design.inbound: Deny all customer inbound, including SSH/RDP; no public IP, load balancer or exposed listener.
design.outbound: Private subnet plus explicit NSG denies for other traffic; preserve required Azure platform traffic. No package downloads, extensions, apt update or remote script URLs.

resources.reason: New, dedicated, empty, disposable scope; not created.
Empty hot, non-HNS blob account; LRS is cheapest sufficient synthetic verifier storage, not a recovery design.
Created empty by approved management-plane deployment, with publicAccess None; allows meaningful authenticated empty List Blobs, no sample blob writes.
One isolated regional VNet with the two private subnets described above.
Attach to the verifier NIC; deny inbound and constrain outbound. PE subnet has no delegated service and privateEndpointNetworkPolicies Disabled for this simple pairing.
PE in the private-endpoint subnet, same proposed region/VNet; includes its platform-created NIC. Approved binding must be observed, not inferred.
Dedicated zone with VNet link, registration disabled, and PE privateDnsZoneGroup/A-record association. No shared DNS zone changes.
Resolve the normal storage hostname privately inside this VNet.
Manage the PE's blob A record automatically; observe actual record and private address after creation.
Private address in verifier subnet, no publicIpAddress association; accelerated networking not required.
Smallest practical current-generation Bsv2 x64 option: 2 burstable vCPUs, 1 GiB RAM; fixed stdlib-only probe, no server or agent install. SKU/quota/capacity remain unconfirmed.
Single nonshared managed OS disk; confirm image minimum size before finalizing. No data disk.
Read-only data-plane access to this one empty container; principal/assignment IDs are unknown until real creation.

verifier.image: Proposed standard Canonical Ubuntu 24.04 LTS Gen2 x64, cloud-init ready; not Ubuntu Pro
verifier.bootDiagnostics: Managed; no customer diagnostics storage account, no claims data in serial logs
verifier.execution: Only separately reviewed fixed cloud-init custom data: write a stdlib Python verifier and bounded systemd timer. Package update/upgrade/install disabled; image must contain Python3, CA trust and cloud-init.
verifier.output: Small nonsecret JSON records to /dev/ttyS0 and local guest log; no token, SAS, key, full HTTP headers or real data.
verifier.retrieval: Separately authorized operator uses az vm boot-diagnostics get-boot-log with explicit subscription/group/actual VM name. Internally minted diagnostic SAS must not be logged; no get-boot-log-uris export.
verifier.freshnessRule: Match actual VM IMDS identity, approved script hash, execution nonce and observation timestamp. Poll serial snapshots; stale/missing/truncated records or script errors mean unknown, never verified.
verifier.billingWarning: The timer stops probes, not Azure billing. Explicit operator deallocation and deletion are still required.

requiredProofAfterApproval.requiredEvidence: Successful real deployment/operation IDs, actual scoped resource IDs, creation times, deployed template/script hashes, and no pre-existing or unowned resources.
Fresh ARM observation of all storageControls, with timestamp, resource ID and ETag where available.
PE provisioning Succeeded, connection Approved, exact new storage resource ID, blob group ID, VNet/subnet ID and PE NIC private IP.
Linked dedicated private DNS zone and A record; the guest resolves the normal <actual-account>.blob.core.windows.net hostname to the actual PE NIC private IP. No hosts-file override.
Guest TCP/TLS connection to port 443, peer socket address matching that PE private IP, validated certificate/hostname and TLS version; guest source VM/NIC identity and time.

IMDS token for https://storage.azure.com/ kept in memory; HTTPS List Blobs on the exact empty container returns HTTP 200 and an empty enumeration. Record x-ms-request-id, client request ID, time, method, target, body hash and empty count, but no credentials.
New property/binding/DNS/socket/data-plane observations after rollback timestamp; do not reuse the pre-seed proof.

requiredOperatorPermissions: Create the single named RG in the selected subscription, or have its authorized owner create it; no blanket Owner assignment is requested.
Read/write/delete only the listed Network, Compute, Storage and deployment resources in this dedicated RG; approve only this account's blob private endpoint connection.
An authorized RBAC administrator must assign/read/delete Storage Blob Data Reader for the newly created VM principal at the exact container scope. Resource Contributor alone cannot assign this role.
Read scoped deployment operations and runtime metadata; Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/retrieveBootDiagnosticsData/action on the verifier VM to retrieve managed serial diagnostics.
Separately approved seed/rollback requires storage account write on the exact new account; never listKeys, assign broad data roles, register providers or modify another resource group.
Manifest-scoped cleanup requires delete on these owned resources and removal of only the exact role assignment created for this test.
verifierPermissions: Storage Blob Data Reader at the single empty container; no ARM write, no blob write/delete, no subscription roles
permissions.providerRegistration: Microsoft.Resources, Microsoft.Compute, Microsoft.Network and Microsoft.Storage state must be checked before deployment; any registration requires separate explicit permission.

seedAndRollback.scope: Only the actual claims-store resource deployed by this approved sandbox run; resource ID not yet assigned.
preconditions: Independent explicit post-baseline seed consent; named operator present with a ready rollback path.
Complete fresh baseline proof above, authenticated empty listing, no real data, no IP/VNet allow rules, anonymous/shared-key access disabled.
Save exact resource ID, baseline protected fields/ETag, desired-state hash, ownership manifest and timestamps; re-read before each write and stop on unrelated changes.
seedAndRollback.meaning: Intentional configuration mismatch for CP-01. Deny-all network ACLs remain: this is not evidence that anonymous or internet data access succeeded.
seedAndRollback.observation: Immediately perform scoped ARM polling; record actual mismatch and measured detection latency. No artificial passing/failing fixture.
seedAndRollback.rollback: In a guarded operator finally path, restore only publicNetworkAccess=Disabled on that same actual account, leaving every other field intact. Re-read protected fields first; if a concurrent edit makes scope/state ambiguous, stop and escalate to the named operator rather than overwrite it.
seedAndRollback.rollbackOnFailure: Named operator restores immediately on timeout, failed observation or lost automation. The 120-second target is not an unattended rollback guarantee. No seed if this fallback is unavailable.
seedAndRollback.postRollback: Repeat all fresh storage/binding/DNS/private-socket/authenticated empty-list checks; unknown if any proof is missing.

plan: Before deletion, restore the desired property, export nonsecret proof/hash receipts, and stop the guest timer; deallocate the VM promptly if cleanup is delayed.
Remove only the recorded container-scoped role assignment, then VM and its OS disk/NIC, PE and managed NIC/zone group, dedicated DNS link/zone, empty container/account, NSG and VNet.

Delete the named RG only if a fresh inventory equals the run's actual ownership manifest, including platform-created children, and no unowned resource is present; otherwise delete only confirmed owned items and escalate.
Confirm deletion of all manifest IDs and absence of orphan disks, NICs, PE, DNS zone and role assignment. Verify residual billing later; deallocation alone leaves disk/PE/DNS charges.

pricing.conservativeFormula: 2 * (0.0104 + 0.01) + 2.40 + 0.50; reserves full monthly disk and zone amounts instead of assuming short-run proration. Not the predicted invoice.
exclusions: Tax, currency conversion, negotiated subscription discounts, free allowances, support and any mandated paid security/monitoring policy.
Standard SSD disk transaction charges and Private Link data-processing charges are not priced here; total invoice is not guaranteed.
Actual DNS query count, retry count, storage operations and cleanup delays; the example 480 probes is not a usage measurement.
PE partial hours are billed as full hours; allow an extra hour if creation/deletion crosses the requested window.
No NAT gateway, public IP, Bastion, VPN, private resolver, paid OS license or Log Analytics workspace is proposed.
The USD 5 monitoring threshold is a proposed operator stop/escalation threshold, not an enforced Azure budget cap.
